svg.aria-label: Map of Windom Park in Northeast Minneapolis with nearby parks, coffee, restaurants, schools and errands

g.data-walk: Ball fields, a zip line playground, a wading pool and winter rinks. About 3 min walk, about 1 min drive.
Pre K to 5, sharing the block with the park and rec center. About 3 min walk, about 2 min drive.
The neighborhood coffee stop on Central. About 15 min walk, about 3 min drive.
Shawarma, the hummus, and a grocery for the pantry. About 18 min walk, about 3 min drive.
Smash burgers on Central. About 17 min walk, about 3 min drive.
A cozy neighborhood spot on Johnson Street. About 16 min walk, about 3 min drive.
Target and Home Depot side by side, one stop for the errand list. About 12 min walk, about 3 min drive.
Grades 6 to 8 on the community pathway. About 17 min walk, about 4 min drive.
Grades 9 to 12 on the community pathway. About 20 min walk, about 4 min drive.
The high point of the city, with big views. About 1.4 mi, about 5 min drive.
Sandwiches worth the drive over to Lowry. About 1.5 mi, about 4 min drive.
Burgers, games and a big patio on University. About 1.6 mi, about 5 min drive.
Down by the river: Greek cooking from our friend Anna. Go hungry. About 2.1 mi, about 7 min drive.
